verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is a terminal coding agent, so a project instructions file for coding standards is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions such a file (for example an AGENTS.md-style or config-based conventions file) or any mechanism for setting persistent conventions. The docs cover codebase reading, approval policies, sandboxing, headless exec, and model configuration, but none of these set standards the agent follows.
